body:
Tested locally on the MRP as well as the [Material Testers demo](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/tree/master/3d/material_testers) with the real-time sky update mode, it works as expected.

However, I'm not 100% sure it's the right solution to the problem. This leads to a slightly different appearance when using 8 roughness layers. This is the default value in the project settings, which produces a warning when using the real-time sky update mode as 7 is preferred instead

Roughness layers | Before | After
-|-|-
7 | ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7dc8a10e-2185-48ac-8fd3-880a4d99d1e7) | ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6e1e5fe7-19b5-44bb-9a51-05eeb1554fe1)
8 | ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7f6eeca8-35fa-43cb-99d7-704f267671d9) | ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/38103fda-68ef-46a9-82eb-931a61592175)
